home.capacity.title: This Week's Capacity
home.capacity.scope: {n} people in your planner scope, independent of Home's projects
home.capacity.visiblePlanned: of available hours planned in your visible view
home.capacity.basis: Planned uses the planner's Confidence: Confirmed and Confidence: Expected bands. Free is available capacity minus planned; time off is already included in available capacity and is not subtracted again. Possible is not subtracted.
home.capacity.partial: Partial view: totals include only projects you can see ({n} people). The percentage describes visible planned hours; Free is unavailable.
home.capacity.provisional: Capacity is unverified for {n} people. Available hours, percentage and Free are unavailable.
home.capacity.missing: Current-week capacity is missing for {n} people. Unknown values are excluded from totals and remain unavailable.
home.capacity.aboveVisible: At least {n} people above 100% this week in visible, verified totals
home.capacity.mark100: The vertical mark in each discipline bar is 100% of available capacity; red is the visible plan above that mark
home.capacity.barLabel: Planned {planned}, Time off {away}, Free {free}, Gross capacity {gross}
home.capacity.drafts: Includes your private drafts, as the planner does. Other people's private drafts and people outside your planner scope are excluded.
